finding: Public ADVFN/InvestorsHub historical news mirrors can preserve the full syndicated wire release plus a second-resolution 'Last update' timestamp. This is a distinct source family from FNSPID, MarketWatch/BZX, Sportmondo and MarketScreener.

verified_examples.title: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Reports Fourth Quarter 2014 and Full Year 2014 Financial Results
Sagent Pharmaceuticals Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2014 Results

admissibility_guardrails: Only a target-specific exact-release mirror may support FOUND.
Verify issuer/title/date against issuer or SEC exhibit.
Treat the mirror Last update field as candidate timestamp-preserving syndication metadata; require chronology and timezone/display semantics to be supportable before canonical promotion.
Do not use message-board post time, replies, conference-call time, EDGAR acceptance, scheduled time, or neighboring release timestamps.
Do not repeat events already checked in this family unless a new exact-release mirror is identified.
worker_strategy: Search exact target release title plus ADVFN/InvestorsHub and 'Last update'.
Prefer mirrors that reproduce the named wire service and complete release text.
Preserve exact mirror URL and displayed Last update timestamp.
Cross-check against issuer/SEC release identity and first illicit trade chronology.
If timezone semantics cannot be defended, record CLUE_ONLY and keep fail-closed.
